QF.id: SIA Social Stock Exchange Introduction and Instruments_17

question.text: According to the 2012 government estimate cited in Chapter 2, approximately how many non-profit organisations are there in India?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook pp.54-55, the 2012 government estimate places India's NPO count at at least 31 lakh non-profit organisations — more than double the number of schools, and about one NPO for every 400 Indians. 31 lakh equals 3.1 million (not 3.1 crore, which would be 31 million). The Trap: Option A (1 lakh) is an order of magnitude too low. Option C (3.1 crore) confuses the decimal system — 3.1 crore equals 310 lakh, off by 10x. Option D (10 lakh) is simply incorrect. Note: Read 31 lakh as 3.1 million to avoid confusing it with 3.1 crore.
